articles.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
articles.snippet: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
articles.snippet: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

articles.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
articles.snippet: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

articles.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
articles.snippet: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

articles.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
articles.snippet: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.
